Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** 02/06/98 Options now are 'EFFECTIVE' and 'TERMINATED'
** The option 'ALL' is now removed. Dates are optional. 
*/
declare
 sWhere varchar2(255) := '';
begin
 execute_trigger( 'validate_dates' );
 check_package_failure;

 if :media_option is not null then
 sWhere := ' and exists ( select campaign_id from campaign_medias ' ||
 'where media_type = ' || in_quotes( :media_option ) ||
 ' and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and campaign_id = campaigns.campaign_id )';
 end if;

 if :camp_option is null then
 :camp_option := 'EFFECTIVE';
-- :camp_option := 'ALL';
 end if;
 if :camp_option = 'EFFECTIVE' then
 if :ctrl_block.eff_date is not null 
 and :ctrl_block.term_date is not null then
 set_block_property( 'campaigns', DEFAULT_WHERE, 
 'eff_date >= :ctrl_block.eff_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and nvl(term_date, eff_date) <= :ctrl_block.term_date ' || sWhere );
 else
 set_block_property( 'campaigns', DEFAULT_WHERE, 
 'eff_date >= trunc(nvl(:ctrl_block.eff_date, eff_date))
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and eff_date <= trunc(nvl(:ctrl_block.term_date, eff_date)) ' || sWhere );
 end if;
 elsif :camp_option = 'TERMINATED' then
 if :ctrl_block.eff_date is not null 
 and :ctrl_block.term_date is not null then
 set_block_property( 'campaigns', DEFAULT_WHERE, 
 ' chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and nvl(term_date, :ctrl_block.term_date + 1) between 
 :ctrl_block.eff_date and :ctrl_block.term_date ' || sWhere );
 else
 set_block_property( 'campaigns', DEFAULT_WHERE, 
 'nvl(term_date, nvl(:ctrl_block.eff_date, trunc(eff_date)) + 1) >= trunc(nvl(:ctrl_block.eff_date, eff_date)) 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and nvl(term_date, decode(:ctrl_block.term_date, null, trunc(eff_date), :ctrl_block.term_date + 1)) <= trunc(nvl(:ctrl_block.term_date, eff_date)) ' || sWhere );
 end if;
 end if;
 go_block( 'campaigns' );
 check_package_failure;
 execute_query;
 if :campaigns.campaign_id is not null then
 if :campaigns.media is not null then
 set_item_property('pb_media_info', enabled, property_true);
 else
 set_item_property('pb_media_info', enabled, property_false);
 end if;
 if :campaigns.note_id is not null then
 set_item_property('pb_campg_notes', enabled, property_true);
 else
 set_item_property('pb_campg_notes', enabled, property_false);
 end if;
 else
 set_item_property('pb_media_info', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('pb_campg_notes', enabled, property_false);
 end if;

 modify_toolbar_buttons('campaigns');
end;
/* 02/06/98 Removed
 if :camp_option = 'ALL' then
 if :ctrl_block.eff_date is not null 
 and :ctrl_block.term_date is not null then
 set_block_property( 'campaigns', DEFAULT_WHERE, 
 'eff_date <= :ctrl_block.term_date
 and term_date >= :ctrl_block.eff_date' || sWhere );
 else
 set_block_property( 'campaigns', DEFAULT_WHERE, '' || sWhere );
 end if;
 elsif :camp_option = 'EFFECTIVE' then
 if :ctrl_block.eff_date is not null 
 and :ctrl_block.term_date is not null then
 set_block_property( 'campaigns', DEFAULT_WHERE, 
 'term_date >= trunc( SYSDATE )
 and eff_date between :ctrl_block.eff_date and :ctrl_block.term_date ' || sWhere );
 else
 set_block_property( 'campaigns', DEFAULT_WHERE, 'term_date >= trunc( SYSDATE )' || sWhere );
 end if;
 elsif :camp_option = 'TERMINATED' then
 if :ctrl_block.eff_date is not null 
 and :ctrl_block.term_date is not null then
 set_block_property( 'campaigns', DEFAULT_WHERE, 
 'term_date < trunc( SYSDATE )
 and term_date between :ctrl_block.eff_date and :ctrl_block.term_date ' || sWhere );
 else
 set_block_property( 'campaigns', DEFAULT_WHERE, 'term_date < trunc( SYSDATE )' || sWhere );
 end if;
 end if;
*/

Trigger.Name: PRE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 nCount number := 0;
begin
 if :campaigns.campaign_id is not null then
 if :campaigns.media is not null then
 set_item_property('pb_media_info', enabled, property_true);
 else
 set_item_property('pb_media_info', enabled, property_false);
 end if;
 if :campaigns.note_id is not null then
 set_item_property('pb_campg_notes', enabled, property_true);
 else
 set_item_property('pb_campg_notes', enabled, property_false);
 end if;
 select nvl( count(*), 0 )
 into nCount
 from campaign_items
 where campaign_items.campaign_id = :campaigns.campaign_id
 and campaign_items.chapter_id = :campaigns.chapter_id;
 if nCount > 0 then
 set_item_property('pb_campg_items', enabled, property_true);
 else
 set_item_property('pb_campg_items', enabled, property_false);
 end if;
 else
 set_item_property('pb_media_info', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('pb_campg_notes', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('pb_campg_items', enabled, property_false);
 end if;

 :drive_sel.campaign_short_name := :campaigns.campaign_short_name;
 :drive_sel.theme := :campaigns.theme;

 if :campaigns.campaign_id is not null then
 select nvl( count(*), 0 )
 into :drive_sel.drive_count
 from drives
 where drives.campaign_id = :campaigns.campaign_id
 and drives.chapter_id = :campaigns.chapter_id;
 end if;
 if :drive_sel.drive_count > 0 then
 set_item_property('pb_drive_details', enabled, property_true);
-- set_item_property('pb_attached_event', enabled, property_true);
 else
 set_item_property('pb_drive_details', enabled, property_false);
-- set_item_property('pb_attached_event', enabled, property_false);
 end if;
exception
 when others then
 null;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 media varchar2(30);
 media_type varchar2(30);
-- , b.code 
 cursor cur_media is
 select nvl( substr( a.media_type, 1, 1 ), ' ' )
 from campaign_medias a, valid_master_codes b
 where a.campaign_id(+) = :campaigns.campaign_id
 and a.media_type(+) = b.code
 and b.code_type = 'MEDIA'
 and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id -- IM# 5320
 order by b.sort_sequence_2;

begin
 media := null;
 open cur_media;
 loop
 fetch cur_media
 into media_type;
 exit when cur_media%notfound;
 media := media || media_type;
-- message (media);
-- copy('Y', media);
 end loop;
 close cur_media;
 :campaigns.media := media;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-CHECK-DELETE-MASTER

--

--

 --

 --

 CLOSE DRIVES_cur;

 END IF;
 CLOSE DRIVES_cur;
 --
 -- End DRIVES detail program section

 --

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 recstat VARCHAR2(20) := :System.record_status; 
 startitm VARCHAR2(61) := :System.cursor_item; 
 rel_id Relation;
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 IF ( recstat = 'NEW' or recstat = 'INSERT' ) THEN 
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 --
 -- Begin CENTRAL_NOTES detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:CAMPAIGNS.NOTE_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('CAMPAIGNS.CAMPAIGN_NOTES'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'CENTRAL_NOTES'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End CENTRAL_NOTES detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:CAMPAIGNS.CAMPAIGN_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('CAMPAIGNS.CAMP_MEDIA'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin DRIVES detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:CAMPAIGNS.CAMPAIGN_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('CAMPAIGNS.CAMPAIGNS_DRIVES'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'DRIVES'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End DRIVES detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin CAMPAIGN_ITEMS detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:CAMPAIGNS.CAMPAIGN_ID is not null) or (:CAMPAIGNS.CHAPTER_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('CAMPAIGNS.CAMPAIGNS_CAMPAIGN_ITEMS'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'CAMPAIGN_ITEMS'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End CAMPAIGN_ITEMS detail program section
 --

 IF ( :System.cursor_item <> startitm ) THEN 
 Go_Item(startitm); 
 Check_Package_Failure; 
 END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;
